text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep winning like this and leave 
everyone speechless. I passionately 
insisted that Narita Taishin could do it, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you get so carried away actually 
started making me feel embarrassed.
choice_data_list:
We won, so we've gotta celebrate with all 
we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'll go change and head home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin walked away with blunt 
words, but there was something about her 
retreating figure that looked pleased.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not weak... I was faster than anyone 
out there...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"What's with that smirk you've had on your 
face for a while now? Could you cut it 
out?"
choice_data_list: I was just so happy, I couldn't help it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. Like I care if you're happy or 
not.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "...Because I only run to win for myself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Narita Taishin's words, I felt her 
fierce determination to seize victory.
